## Request

> We want a skill for implementers that writes the commit message for a change: an imperative subject of 72 characters or fewer, a blank line, then a body saying what changed and why. Call it commit-message-writer. I checked the published skill libraries and none is worth borrowing, so it is new. Write the skill and its cases today; the team wants to try it on Friday.
